limitations: Counts describe original assay rows, not independent randomized temperature units.
The same Picture ID label may recur across temperature replicates; no rows are deduplicated.
Mating types and strains are kept separate; their counts are not pooled into effects.
Run.Num and Temp.Rep are source codes, not verified independent growth chambers.
Strain 3 splits some recorded temperature/run groups by mating-type run codes.
No growth rate, temperature-response model, significance test or causal effect is estimated.
